title: Workstation / Power & energy
description: Understand PSU DC power, sampled energy, electricity cost estimates and separate household tariff charges.

options.content: **PSU DC output** is the workstation's delivered power, not electricity drawn at the wall. GPU board readings are part of that load: do not add them to PSU output. The energy cards below are cumulative sampled estimates; they are not energy for the selected dashboard range or an inference task. GPU power and temperature can be blank while cards are runtime-suspended. Missing GPU readings do not mean zero watts or a PSU telemetry failure.

panels.title: PSU DC output power (not wall power)
panels.description: Corsair native hwmon total, not the sum of total and rails. Missing, ambiguous or stale readings are gaps. This excludes PSU conversion losses and is not AC socket power.

targets.expr: workstation_psu_output_power_watts{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)

panels.title: PSU DC rail power
panels.description: Components of PSU output; never add these to total power. Unknown sensors are absent.

targets.expr: workstation_psu_rail_power_watts{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)

panels.title: Tracked DC energy estimate (cumulative kWh)
panels.description: Latest cumulative integral since private sampler state was created, NOT energy for the selected dashboard range or billed AC energy. Only covered intervals count; consult coverage alongside this number. Prometheus retains history for at most 14 days / 24 GB.

targets.expr: (workstation_psu_output_energy_joules_total{job="node"} / 3600000) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)

panels.title: Tracked energy coverage (cumulative time)
panels.description: Elapsed intervals actually integrated, not workstation uptime. Reboots, missing readings, clock/device changes and gaps over 90 seconds are excluded. Zero coverage means no measured interval yet, not zero power consumption.

targets.expr: workstation_psu_energy_covered_seconds_total{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)

panels.title: GPU board power · compare cards
panels.description: Per-card board readings. They exclude CPU, drives and PSU conversion losses.

panels.title: GPU temperature channels
panels.description: Native hwmon labels identify edge, junction and memory channels per PCI address. No unsupported device temperature limit is inferred.

targets.expr: label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="node"} * on(job,instance,chip) group_left(chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{job="node",chip_name="amdgpu"} * on(job,instance,chip,sensor) group_left(label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{job="node"}, "pci_bdf", "$1.$2", "chip", ".*_(0000:[0-9a-f]{2}:[0-9a-f]{2})_([0-7])") and on(job,instance,pci_bdf) workstation_gpu_info{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_hardware_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_hardware_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)

panels.title: PSU sensor availability
panels.description: A value of 1 means the sampler observed an unambiguous supported PSU sensor.

panels.title: PSU sample age
panels.description: The power charts exclude samples older than 90 seconds or more than 10 seconds in the future.

panels.title: Tracked energy coverage over time
panels.description: Cumulative sampled intervals. Flat sections while power samples are missing do not establish zero consumption.

options.content:
**These are tariff-valued PSU DC estimates, not a metered electricity bill.** PSU losses and unobserved intervals are excluded. The standing charge belongs to the household supply and is shown separately; it is not added to workstation usage.

The cards show the selected VAT-inclusive rates. Exact Flexible tariff code and payment method enable hourly public Octopus API updates. Source shows **API**, **cached** or **manual fallback**. Selected-window energy is valued at the current rate, not reconstructed historical billing. Missing edge history or expired observations stay unavailable.

panels.title: Electricity unit rate · incl VAT
panels.description: The currently selected live, cached or manually supplied unit price. VAT-inclusive public API prices are used without adding VAT again.

panels.title: Household standing charge · incl VAT
panels.description: Whole electricity supply charge, due independently of workstation operation. It is deliberately separate from usage-cost panels.

panels.title: Tariff source
panels.description: API = successful current lookup; cached = refresh failed but a same-config unexpired cached rate is at most 26 hours old; manual = the owner-supplied fallback.

targets.expr: workstation_tariff_mode{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (time() < workstation_tariff_valid_until_seconds{job="node"}) and on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)

panels.title: Current energy cost rate · DC proxy
panels.description: GBP per hour at the current observed PSU DC watts and unit price. Excludes PSU conversion losses and the household standing charge.

targets.expr: ((workstation_psu_output_power_watts{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)) / 1000) * on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_unit_price_gbp_per_kwh{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (time() < workstation_tariff_valid_until_seconds{job="node"}) and on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10))
targets.legendFormat: Current energy cost rate · DC proxy

panels.title: 24 hours at current load · DC proxy
panels.description: A constant-load 24-hour projection, not observed daily expenditure or a forecast. Excludes standing charge and PSU losses.

targets.expr: (((workstation_psu_output_power_watts{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)) / 1000) * on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_unit_price_gbp_per_kwh{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (time() < workstation_tariff_valid_until_seconds{job="node"}) and on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10))) * 24
targets.legendFormat: 24 hours at current load · DC proxy

panels.title: Selected-window energy · priced now
panels.description: Difference of measured cumulative DC energy counters near both selected-window edges, priced at the current rate. No increase/extrapolation. Missing boundaries or an observed counter reset refuse a value. Tariff changes revalue this estimate; it is not historic billed cost.

targets.expr: ((((workstation_psu_output_energy_joules_total{job="node"}) - (workstation_psu_output_energy_joules_total{job="node"} offset $__range)) and on(job,instance) (resets(workstation_psu_output_energy_joules_total{job="node"}[$__range]) == 0) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_output_energy_joules_total{job="node"} >= (workstation_psu_output_energy_joules_total{job="node"} offset $__range)) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_available{job="node"} offset $__range == 1) and on(job,instance) ((time() - $__range_s) - (workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} offset $__range) <= 90) and on(job,instance) ((workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} offset $__range) - (time() - $__range_s) <= 10)) / 3600000) * on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_unit_price_gbp_per_kwh{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (time() < workstation_tariff_valid_until_seconds{job="node"}) and on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10))

panels.title: Covered sample hours · selected window
panels.description: Observed counter difference at the selected edges. Gaps excluded by the existing energy sampler stay excluded; sampling means edges are approximate.

targets.expr: (((workstation_psu_energy_covered_seconds_total{job="node"}) - (workstation_psu_energy_covered_seconds_total{job="node"} offset $__range)) and on(job,instance) (resets(workstation_psu_energy_covered_seconds_total{job="node"}[$__range]) == 0) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_covered_seconds_total{job="node"} >= (workstation_psu_energy_covered_seconds_total{job="node"} offset $__range)) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_energy_available{job="node"} offset $__range == 1) and on(job,instance) ((time() - $__range_s) - (workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} offset $__range) <= 90) and on(job,instance) ((workstation_psu_energy_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} offset $__range) - (time() - $__range_s) <= 10)) / 3600

panels.title: Age of last successful API lookup
panels.description: No value is expected before an exact tariff has been configured and successfully fetched. A cached source retains its original successful lookup time.

targets.legendFormat: Age of last successful API lookup

panels.title: Automatic lookup configured
panels.description: Requires the exact single-register Flexible tariff code and DIRECT_DEBIT/NON_DIRECT_DEBIT payment method. No account number, API key or meter data is used.

panels.title: Energy cost rate over time · DC proxy
panels.description: Each point uses the tariff observed at that time and fresh PSU DC output. This is an hourly cost rate, not an accumulated bill. Missing tariff or power observations remain gaps.

targets.expr: ((workstation_psu_output_power_watts{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_available{job="node"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} <= 90) and on(job,instance) (workstation_psu_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10)) / 1000) * on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_unit_price_gbp_per_kwh{job="node"} and on(job,instance) (time() < workstation_tariff_valid_until_seconds{job="node"}) and on(job,instance) (workstation_tariff_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="node"} - time() <= 10))
